title: Contains Duplicate II
summary: Decide whether two different positions contain the same value and are at most k positions apart.

contractDetails.output-checking: Exact typed equality of the returned bool.

statement: Decide whether two different positions contain the same value and are at most k positions apart.

examples.explanation: The two 4s are exactly two positions apart.
Distinct positions cannot be distance zero.
The repeated value is too far apart.

hints: Conceptual: Only nearby earlier positions can form a valid pair.
Directional: Remember the latest position of each value.
Implementation: For each value, test the distance from its last occurrence before updating that position.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(n) auxiliary hash-table space.
